proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5994.2 *trāyaḥ explicitly gives Torwali and Maiya c̣ā three. Selected ʦ̣ā/ʦ̣ā̃ and Maiya cā fit this long-a branch, retaining source affricate/retroflex notation and isolated nasalisation. The parent is the specific *trāyaḥ subsection rather than trayaḥ or trīṇi; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: ʦ̣ā̃.
